summary_1line: Vidura, Drona, Gandhari, and Dhritarashtra urge Duryodhana to grant the Pandavas their rightful share and avert the Kuru dynasty’s destruction.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vidura stands sorrowfully in the royal assembly, warning that Duryodhana’s greed will destroy the Kuru race as kings and elders listen in silence.
Queen Gandhari, veiled and stern, rises before the gathered monarchs and publicly condemns Duryodhana’s unrighteous claim to the throne.
The blind king Dhritarashtra addresses Duryodhana in the crowded court while Bhishma, Drona, and the assembled rulers watch anxiously.
